description: This file provides interfaces and utility functions for manipulating and reasoning about symbolic shapes within PyTorch's FX symbolic shapes system. It includes classes, functions for symbolic expression evaluation, shape constraints, symbol binding analysis, and related symbolic reasoning utilities used heavily in dynamic shape support and compilation workflows.

classes.name: Specialization
classes.description: This class is used in multi-graph compilation contexts where multiple specialized graphs are generated, enabling optimized dispatch based on runtime conditions.

classes.name: ConvertIntKey
classes.description: Represents a key for converting an expression to a SymInt without guards.

classes.name: CallMethodKey
classes.description: Represents a key for calling a method on an object, used for symbolic shape analysis.

classes.name: InnerTensorKey
classes.description: Represents a key for accessing an inner tensor attribute.

classes.name: DivideByKey
classes.description: Represents a key for dividing a SymInt by a constant divisor.

classes.name: Constraint
classes.description: Base class for various shape constraints with a warn_only attribute.

classes.name: StrictMinMaxConstraint
classes.description: Constraint specifying that the size at a dimension must be within a specified range, with non-negativity and non-1/0 considerations.

classes.name: RelaxedUnspecConstraint
classes.description: Constraint indicating no explicit specified constraint, inferred by guards.

classes.name: EqualityConstraint
classes.description: Represents equality constraints between input sources, managing source pairs and derived equalities with transitive closure.

classes.name: SymbolicContext
classes.description: Abstract base class defining symbolic creation context for shape dimensions.

classes.name: SymIntSymbolicContext
classes.description: Specifies constraints on SymInt inputs within a symbolic context.

classes.name: StatelessSymbolicContext
classes.description: Creates symbols based on dynamic sizes and constraints, with parameters for constraint and dynamic policies.

classes.name: StatefulSymbolicContext
classes.description: Extends StatelessSymbolicContext with cache for reuse of symbolic decisions, tied to tensor shape sources.

classes.name: SubclassSymbolicContext
classes.description: Provides inner context mappings for traceable tensor subclasses, enabling differentiated symbolic info.

classes.name: TrackedFake
classes.description: Tracks the origin and associated symbolic source of fake tensors for shape guard computations.

classes.name: SymExprPrinter
classes.description: Printer class for converting sympy.Float objects into string representations.

classes.name: _ShapeGuardPrinter
classes.description: Abstract base class for symbolic expression writers with source mapping capabilities.

classes.name: ShapeGuardPythonPrinter
classes.description: Python code generator extension for shape guard expressions, with caching.

classes.name: ShapeGuardPrinter
classes.description: Deprecated: Alias for ShapeGuardPythonPrinter, kept for backward compatibility.

classes.name: _ShapeGuardCppPrinter
classes.description: C++ code generator for shape guard expressions, managing source to symbol mappings.

classes.name: LoggingShapeGuardPrinter
classes.description: Shape guard printer that logs source mappings for debugging.

classes.name: DynamicDimConstraintPrinter
classes.description: Printer generates code to express constraints of symbolic dimension in a dynamic shape context.

classes.name: DimConstraints
classes.description: Solver class for handling systems of constraints on symbolic shapes, including inequalities and equalities.
